user.title: Connect CHEF iQ cloud
user.description: Enter your CHEF iQ account email and password. Passwords are not saved. The saved-session option is only for importing an existing locally prepared session. Wi-Fi and combined sensors are added alongside the official Bluetooth integration.

error.session_missing: Saved session missing. Uncheck saved session to sign in.
error.wrong_account: Use the same account as before.

init.title: Cook controls
init.description: Sensors and cook notifications work with controls off. Enabling controls allows Home Assistant to start, continue and end cooks on your hub and add new cooks to your CHEF iQ account history. An earlier experimental version preceded a hub reset that cleared active sessions. The cause remains unknown.
